'''Coronet Zoo''' was a [[Zoo/Legends|zoo]] in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="Coronet Zoo" /> It was struck by a stray [[Missile/Legends|rocket]] sometime during the [[Battle of Corellia]], and many of the zoo's creatures were freed, allowing them to prey on both civilians and other zoo animals.

The numerous [[jaggalor]]s of the zoo that escaped from its enclosures were domesticated by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], however, and were unleashed upon the [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during their battle on Corellia. A jaggalor was tended to by either one or two Republic feeders.<ref name="Jaggalors on the Loose">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Jaggalors on the Loose|Corellia}}</ref>

Coronet Zoo contained at least one [[Acklay/Legends|acklay]], three [[Nexu/Legends|nexu]], and several jaggalors.<ref name="Coronet Zoo" />
